items.title: Willie Foster Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] By the way, do you remember Johnny Dodds? I know his brother very well is still living, Baby Dodds. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, both of them drummers.

ctx.x: He sure did. Way back there. Played with Bolden. Mm-hmm. And he played with the crescent band too.
Mm-hmm. By the way, do you remember Johnny Dodds? I know his brother very well is still living, Baby Dodds.
